opportunity: Five Star Grant Program 2026
geography: National; good for Chicago watershed/open-space projects
fit_for_gcc: Use for Roosevelt Road/North Lawndale stewardship tied to waterways, trash/debris prevention, public open space, outreach, volunteer stewardship, small habitat/tree/rain-garden enhancements.
typical_amount_or_range: Modest grants; NFWF metrics include pounds of trash/debris removed/prevented
deadline_or_cycle: Full proposal due June 4, 2026, 11:59 PM ET
eligibility_notes: Eligible applicants generally include nonprofits and local partnerships; strong partner letters expected
prep_items: Define restoration site; add watershed/public-space partner; create trash/debris baseline; collect GIS/photos; secure letters; build 12-24 month workplan and budget.

opportunity: Chi-Cal Rivers Fund
funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation + Chicago/Calumet partners
fit_for_gcc: Best if GCC connects neighborhood cleanup to Chicago River/Calumet runoff, illegal dumping hot spots, nature-based stormwater work, restored habitat activation, and community engagement.
typical_amount_or_range: Recent 2026 slate announced $1.2M total; award sizes vary
deadline_or_cycle: 2025 round closed July 30, 2025; monitor for 2026/2027 RFP
eligibility_notes: 501(c) nonprofits eligible; project must benefit major waterways/tributaries; capacity and maintenance plan important
prep_items: Map eligible blocks to tributary/watershed; identify landowner/site control; 5-year maintenance plan; partner with Openlands/MWRD/park district/community orgs.

opportunity: Illinois EPA Section 319(h) Nonpoint Source Pollution Control Grants
fit_for_gcc: Fit if GCC frames litter/illegal dumping and green infrastructure as nonpoint-source pollution prevention in a watershed plan; can include education and BMP implementation.
deadline_or_cycle: FY2026 NOFO anticipated June 2026
eligibility_notes: Local units and other organizations; GATA portal prequalification required
prep_items: Get GATA prequalification; identify watershed-based plan; quantify water-quality benefits; partner with municipality/watershed group; prepare BMP/education budget.

opportunity: SCALE Streambank Cleanup and Lakeshore Enhancement
fit_for_gcc: Strong fit if GCC establishes recurring streambank/lakeshore litter cleanups with community participants and safety/equipment needs.
deadline_or_cycle: Deadline TBD
eligibility_notes: Applicant must be pre-qualified in Illinois Grants Portal; recurring cleanup history; FEIN and DUNS/SAM Cage Code required
prep_items: Start recurring cleanup calendar now; document participants; bags; pounds; photos; complete GATA/SAM; list safety attire; dumpsters; tipping fees, promotional materials.

opportunity: Green Infrastructure Grant Opportunities (GIGO)
fit_for_gcc: Good for larger stormwater/green-infrastructure projects that complement clean blocks: rain gardens, bioswales, permeable surfaces, community stewardship around runoff.
deadline_or_cycle: Current page says applications through Nov. 5, 2025; monitor for next cycle
eligibility_notes: Public/private nonprofit organizations eligible among others; construction of green infrastructure BMPs
prep_items: Find site-control partner; engineering/design; hydrology rationale; maintenance plan; match sources; construction budget.

opportunity: City of Chicago Community Development Grants (Small/Medium/Large)
funder: City of Chicago Department of Planning and Development
fit_for_gcc: Fit for a GCC operations/training hub, equipment storage, community facility, worker-support space, or mixed-use neighborhood quality-of-life project.
typical_amount_or_range: Small up to $250k; Medium $300001-$5M; Large over $5M
deadline_or_cycle: Applications open; source lists Aug. 14, 2026 at 11:59 PM for small/medium, large rolling
eligibility_notes: Business/property owners; nonprofits; community developers; entrepreneurs in Chicago; capital/real-estate focus
prep_items: Secure site/control or landlord partner; capital budget; architectural scope; community benefits/job creation; MBE/WBE plan; operating sustainability.

opportunity: Chicago Department of Public Health Community-Centered Wellness Microgrant Program
funder: City of Chicago Department of Public Health
fit_for_gcc: Fit if GCC emphasizes neighborhood cleanliness as public health, wellbeing, violence prevention through paid local action, and community cohesion.
deadline_or_cycle: Response due May 22 2026 at 12:00 PM CT
eligibility_notes: Delegate-agency RFP; questions date has passed as of May 14 2026
prep_items: Download solicitation immediately; adapt cleanup events to wellness outcomes; prepare city vendor docs; budget; insurance; deliverables.

opportunity: Chicago Fund for Safe and Peaceful Communities
funder: Partnership for Safe and Peaceful Communities / funders
geography: Chicago priority neighborhoods incl. North Lawndale
fit_for_gcc: Fit for summer block activations where paid cleanup creates safer public spaces, resident engagement; and youth/family community cohesion.
deadline_or_cycle: 2026 application deadline March 2; awards May 1
eligibility_notes: Nonprofit/community-based groups; North Lawndale named priority community
prep_items: Prepare annual summer activation calendar by January; partner letters; safety plan; resident leadership; simple outcomes: events; participants; blocks cleaned.

opportunity: The Chicago Community Trust Sponsorships
fit_for_gcc: Fit for GCC launch events, sponsor walks, neighborhood cleanup showcases, funder convenings, or cross-sector partnership events tied to economic mobility/workforce.
deadline_or_cycle: Current window: Apr. 30-May 15, 2026; next window Jun. 8-Jun. 30, 2026
eligibility_notes: 501(c)(3) or fiscal sponsor; benefits Chicago region; event-oriented
prep_items: Create 2-3 public events; sponsorship deck; agenda; speakers; audience; budget; partner list; metrics.

opportunity: The Chicago Community Trust open opportunities
fit_for_gcc: Good relationship target for economic mobility, workforce, community care, neighborhood quality of life, and future special initiatives.
deadline_or_cycle: Open opportunities updated periodically
eligibility_notes: 501(c)(3) agencies or fiscal sponsors; generally Chicago region/Cook County
prep_items: Create GrantCentral account; monitor weekly; prepare common org profile, financials, board list, impact data, demographic/service-area narrative.

opportunity: Walder Foundation Environmental Sustainability
fit_for_gcc: Fit only with nature-based solutions, biodiversity, urban nature, and equitable stewardship; not simple litter pickup alone. Strong as partner/cultivation target.
deadline_or_cycle: Invitation only; foundation generally gives 6-8 weeks after invitation and 2-3 months review
eligibility_notes: Applicants must be in or centered on greater Chicago; invitation required; does not generally fund most capital expenses
prep_items: Cultivate program officer; align with nature-based solutions; build biodiversity/stormwater partner project; collect evidence of community stewardship.

opportunity: The Joyce Foundation Environment / Economic Mobility / Justice Reform
fit_for_gcc: Fit only if GCC includes policy/implementation work around environmental justice, water, workforce, or safe communities; not local cleanup implementation by itself.
deadline_or_cycle: Proposal deadlines Apr. 1, Aug. 3, Dec. 1, 2026
eligibility_notes: Policy-focused; process can take 4-6 months; environment guidelines generally do not fund local cleanup projects
prep_items: Develop policy angle: municipal illegal-dumping response, paid resident stewardship model, workforce standards; request fit call before LOI.

opportunity: ComEd Green Region Grant
fit_for_gcc: Fit for open-space beautification, community gardens, tree canopy, stewardship around GCC-cleaned corridors; pair with paid local workers and local-government letter.
typical_amount_or_range: Part of $515k Power for Good grants in 2026; individual amounts vary
deadline_or_cycle: 2026 deadline March 13, 2026; monitor January 2027
eligibility_notes: Nonprofits eligible in 2026 with letter of support from eligible local government/entity; must be in ComEd territory
prep_items: Secure city/park district letter; choose open-space site; plantings/design; volunteer/worker stewardship plan; maintenance budget.

opportunity: Bank of America Charitable Foundation
fit_for_gcc: Fit for economic mobility, workforce pathways, neighborhood revitalization, and community empowerment aspects of GCC paid work model.
deadline_or_cycle: 2026 application dates posted by funder; verify in portal
eligibility_notes: 501(c)(3); aligns with economic opportunity/community needs
prep_items: Build workforce/economic mobility case; outcomes on income, job readiness, bank access; corporate volunteer/sponsorship angle.

opportunity: Ben & Jerry's Foundation National Grassroots Organizing
fit_for_gcc: Fit if GCC is constituent-led by residents and uses organizing/base-building around environmental justice, not just direct service/cleanup.
deadline_or_cycle: 2026 deadline Feb. 25, 2026, 4 PM ET
eligibility_notes: 501(c)(3) or fiscal sponsor; U.S.-focused; budget under $350k; grassroots organizing primary strategy
prep_items: Document resident leadership/decision power; campaign goals; base-building plan; keep budget under threshold if applying.

opportunity: Patagonia Environmental Grants
fit_for_gcc: Fit only for grassroots environmental protection/restoration with a bold action/campaign component; less fit for direct paid cleanup unless tied to systems-change.
typical_amount_or_range: $5k-$20k commonly listed by grant directories; verify directly
deadline_or_cycle: Directory listed Apr. 30, 2026; verify future cycles with funder
eligibility_notes: 501(c)(3) or fiscal sponsor; grassroots environmental groups
prep_items: Create campaign frame: stop dumping/plastic pollution; community advocacy; direct action outcomes; avoid generic operations-only ask.

opportunity: EPA Environmental Education Grants
fit_for_gcc: Fit for cleaner training curriculum, youth/community education on litter, watersheds, waste, and environmental stewardship.
deadline_or_cycle: 2026 competition closed March 3, 2026; subscribe for future rounds
eligibility_notes: Nonprofit organizations eligible; education focus required
prep_items: Draft reusable curriculum; learning objectives; educator partners; evaluation plan; EPA region contacts; subscribe to listserv.

opportunity: EPA Brownfields Multipurpose, Assessment, and Cleanup Grants
fit_for_gcc: Fit as a partner if GCC works on vacant/abandoned contaminated lots; direct applicant only if site ownership/control and brownfield capacity exist.
typical_amount_or_range: Large federal grants; amount by category
deadline_or_cycle: FY2026 competition underway/monitor EPA page
eligibility_notes: Nonprofits can be eligible in some categories; strict brownfields/site requirements
prep_items: Identify brownfield sites; partner with City/land bank; Phase I/II assessments; community engagement; cleanup/reuse plan.

opportunity: EPA Environmental Justice Collaborative Problem-Solving (EJCPS)
fit_for_gcc: Strong conceptual fit for CBO-led collaboration around local environmental/public health issue such as illegal dumping and sanitation inequity; current availability uncertain.
typical_amount_or_range: Historically up to six figures; varies by NOFO
deadline_or_cycle: No active 2026 NOFO confirmed on EPA page as of research; monitor EPA/Grants.gov
eligibility_notes: Community-based nonprofit or partnership of CBOs; collaborative problem-solving model required
prep_items: Build CBO coalition; problem statement; stakeholder map; CPS model workplan; environmental/public health data; Grants.gov/SAM readiness.

opportunity: Corporate block sponsorships and employee matching
funder: Local employers; hospitals; universities; retailers; property managers
fit_for_gcc: Not a grant, but immediate high-fit revenue: $100/block sponsorships, custom packages, employee volunteer days, and matching gifts.
deadline_or_cycle: Rolling
eligibility_notes: No grant eligibility; sponsorship/tax receipt and corporate CSR fit
prep_items: Create prospect list; 1-page package; W-9/501c3 letter; impact photos; invoice/receipt workflow; employee match instructions.
